name: Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm
summary: Bandits and harvest golems hold Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm in northern Westfall, off the road from Elwynn Forest. Farmer Furlbrow and Verna have lost their home to the Defias Brotherhood.

sections.title: A Harvest Lost
sections.body: Near Westfall's northern border, Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm once fed the kingdom. The Defias Brotherhood drove Farmer Furlbrow and his wife Verna from their land. Now mechanical harvest golems roam the fields and attack anyone who approaches. Bandits occupy the farm buildings, while the rightful owners camp beside the road near the Jansen Stead, mourning their home and livelihood.

sections.title: Defias Stronghold
sections.body: The Defias Brotherhood has claimed homesteads like Furlbrow's while Stormwind's military garrison struggles to protect Westfall's rural farmers. Bandits camp at the farm and use it as a staging ground. Lethal harvest watchers guard the perimeter, leaving travelers on the nearby highway open to ambush.

faq.answer: Farmer Furlbrow and his wife, Verna Furlbrow, own the farm. Outlaws drove them away, and the couple now shelters along the road near the Jansen Stead.
The Defias Brotherhood seized the farm and drove the Furlbrows away. Thugs occupy the buildings, while haywire mechanical harvest golems guard the pumpkin patch.
Farmer Furlbrow and his wife shelter beside the main road just northeast of the farm, near the Jansen Stead. Their cart and belongings are with them.

faq.q: Why are mechanical harvest golems attacking people here?
faq.answer: The mechanical constructs are programmed to attack the people of Westfall and patrol land held by the Defias. Their exact origins remain uncertain.

angles.text: For the Alliance, the overrun farm shows Stormwind has failed to protect its heartland. Loyal farmers are left defenseless against bandits.
